title: PlanReviewAgenticVerdictInput
description: INPUT of `plan_review_agentic_verdict`: the agent's validated findings, its provider provenance, the reviewed ticket's identity, and the Layer-1 floor results the adapter merges into the verdict.

ticket_id.description: The canonical id of the reviewed ticket.

provider_provenance.description: The agent call's runner-stamped provider record, carried onto the verdict.

det_blocking.description: The DET floor's blocking findings (empty on a DET-passing review).

hierarchy_incomplete.description: True when the ticket hierarchy failed to load; the verdict is then INDETERMINATE.
